text.text: :jamegam-yay: *Want a chance to keep going on your game ??!* <!channel> :jamegam-yay:

*:question_1: Wait what??*
the jam is over, but your game doesn't have to be!! keep working on it over the next week and get a prize for the time you put in :jamegam-welcome:

*:jamegam-joystick: how does it work?*
Sign up at <https://savepoint.hackclub.com?utm_source=slack&utm_medium=announcement&utm_campaign=jamegam|savepoint.hackclub.com> | <#C0CBHCHK469>
pick your jam game, or any other game you want to continue
keep building! only time after you submit to the jam counts
ship it when it's better than when you started

*:jamegam-present: and what about prizes??*
save point has everything from aseprite, robux, and steam cards, to keyboards and controllers!
Prizes start at 45 minutes a day!!

blocks.alt_text: Save Point: Finish that game you started. Get a $25 Steam card, an 8BitDo 2C or a Keychron K2.

text.text: *save point ends November 2nd at 4PM EST so go now!!!!!*
